pillar_reactions.evidence: He interrupted the presentation with a direct mechanics question — 'I have a question. Even if I don't do three to four days, what's the other options?' — and then surfaced the real scheduling conflict, that his football officiating season runs Wednesday to Saturday from late August with educational trainings on top. The rep answered adequately (frequency can flex, communicate with Trevor). He engaged again on the mobility component, tying it to his own stake: 'I don't want to lose what I have. I'm not as fast as I was 25 years ago, but I'm able to run with no problems, and that's the key thing. Because if I couldn't run, sit your butt down.' Understood the mechanics and probed them rather than reacting to the value.

Presented as the when/what/how-much frame, whole foods, minimal processed, no chicken and rice, plus an eating window, with the rep noting he does not cook much and offering to keep it simple. He agreed — 'Yeah, it could work for me, yes' — and then added his own framing: 'in reduction of caloric intake, that's important. So I don't have as many calories now that I may have eaten when I was 20, 30 years ago.' Agreed without questions. Critically, neither party connected any of this to his diabetes, which he had disclosed twice.

Delivered as the teach-a-man-to-fish pillar with video form feedback, Trevor's number, Thursday lives and chasing messages. His response was agreement laced with a signal worth noting: 'No, no, no. I understand. Like I said, I've been exposed to training, you know, acronyms, so, no big.' Asked whether any part stood out he said 'No, not right now', and then explained he had been through a lot of comparable coach education through USA Track and Field. He accepted the pillar while quietly establishing that he already knows this material — which is the seed of why he ended the call buying a self-study course rather than coaching.

anchors.raw: I'm fortunate that my income supersedes most retirees... It's well over six figures. Okay. And I'm like, okay, fine.
anchors.note: Volunteered unprompted, twenty minutes before price, along with two income sources and multiple pensions. On paper this is the strongest affordability signal in the batch — and it turned out to predict nothing, because every dollar is committed monthly. The most useful data point in this call for the ICP question: 'makes good money' and 'can pay for this' are not the same criterion.

anchors.raw: I don't have anything available right now... a lot of my money is going out to pay because I'm living by myself. So all my payments went right out the door... I'm paying insurance, I'm paying rental, paying loans and stuff like that, because all the educational stuff.
anchors.note: The controlling anchor. Zero available today, a single $400 credit line held back for emergencies, and a fixed monthly outflow on rent, insurance and education loans. He is high-income and cash-poor, and he polices the distinction himself: 'penny wise, not pound foolish' and 'I don't want to be out in the street.'

anchors.raw: because I'm turning 70, my increase comes in September... It's going to be probably close to $4,000 to maybe $6,000 raise, which is a lot of money that is going to be free for me to use
anchors.note: A known, dated uplift roughly equal to the full programme price, arriving in about five weeks. This is what made the deal survivable — it converts an affordability objection into a scheduling one, and the rep correctly built the bridge to reach it rather than fighting it.

anchors.raw: I belong to what they call, you've probably heard of it, Planet Fitness, I belong to a lot of these things. It's just getting to those spaces.
anchors.competitor: Planet Fitness plus his apartment complex gym
anchors.note: He already pays for gym access at a tiny fraction of the price and does not use it — which is simultaneously the cheap anchor and the proof that cheap access does not solve his problem. The rep caught the second half of that and used it to establish the root cause, but never turned it back on the price.

anchors.raw: I have certifications to do all that kind of stuff... I mean, I have certification where I can coach athletes internationally or domestically here in the United States
anchors.note: He is a credentialled track coach who has run collegiate programmes for six years, owns a rowing machine, a kettlebell, a mobility stick and a sauna blanket, and has watched Trevor's free videos for a year. The knowledge gap is close to zero and he says so. This is exactly the anchor P4f exists to dismantle, and it was never touched — which is why the $200 self-study tier, the product that sells him information he already has, felt like the natural landing point.

anchors.raw: the only other thing that I could think of is, if you see a way of making that work. We can do $200 a month. That's more of like a self-study program.
anchors.note: Distinct from the discount-reflex seen on the Jimin Bhuptani call. Here the lower tier was introduced only after a full liquidity probe established there was genuinely nothing available, and it was framed as a creditable bridge to the full price rather than as a cheaper substitute. That is the defensible use of it, and the prospect reacted to it as rescue rather than as a discount: 'Now you got me' and 'I was like, okay, this is not going to work. But if you had another option, I said, okay, I can go with that.'

anchors.raw: I already heard from Kim that he already gave you an insight from what the costs are going to look like
anchors.note: The setter pre-framed the price before the call, and it shows — the prospect raised cost calmly and early as a logistics question rather than reacting to $6,000 as a shock. Contrast with the Edward Garcia and Omar calls in this batch, where price landed cold on a lead one day old. Worth capturing as evidence that setter price pre-framing changes the shape of the close.

unmet_demand.want: A training and nutrition protocol that is safe and appropriate for a 25-year diabetic with suspected kidney involvement
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He disclosed the diabetes twice and it was never acknowledged, so nothing was adapted, qualified or even discussed. The nutrition pillar as sold — eating windows, a calorie deficit, 'your body's just going to tell you I'm full' — interacts directly with blood glucose management and medication timing, and no clinician was mentioned on either side. Whether the programme can serve him safely is genuinely unknown from this transcript, and it is the single most important open question in this batch.

unmet_demand.want: Kettlebell instruction he can carry into his own coaching and teach to young athletes
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He named this explicitly and at length — 'this is going to be another piece that I can add to my coaching repertoire to show kids how they can develop their strength', tying it to explosive strength and coordination for track and field, and to Olympic lifting alternatives for athletes who cannot do them. The rep gestured at it once ('you can also pass it on to other people') but nobody established whether the material is intended or permitted to be taught onward, or whether coach-facing content exists. This is arguably a different product than the one being sold.

unmet_demand.want: Programming that survives an officiating season running Wednesday to Saturday from late August through November, plus educational trainings
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The rep addressed it in principle — frequency can drop to two or three sessions, communicate with Trevor and the schedule changes — which is a reasonable answer. Nothing concrete was committed to, and the prospect raised it twice, so it remains a stated risk rather than a solved one. Likely served in practice.

unmet_demand.want: Training built around a chronic lumbar injury and active tendinitis in the foot and knee, in a 70-year-old
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The injuries were properly elicited, including their origin and severity, and then folded straight into the sales narrative — a daily mobility routine that will make the back 'stronger again'. That is a therapeutic claim made about an injury that currently requires chiropractic care, in a movement system built on loaded hip hinges, with no qualification and no clinical input.
